title: Flashcards: Mammals, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about mammals. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Finlayson’s Squirrel?
cards.explain: The Finlayson’s Squirrel is Callosciurus finlaysonii.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the grey wolf?
cards.explain: The grey wolf is Canis lupus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the De Brazza's monkey?
cards.explain: The De Brazza's monkey is Cercopithecus neglectus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the crab-eating fox?
cards.explain: The crab-eating fox is Cerdocyon thous.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Greater white-toothed shrew?
cards.explain: The Greater white-toothed shrew is Crocidura russula.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Speke's gazelle?
cards.explain: The Speke's gazelle is Gazella spekei.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Peale's dolphin?
cards.explain: The Peale's dolphin is Lagenorhynchus australis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Argentine Plains Viscacha?
cards.explain: The Argentine Plains Viscacha is Lagostomus maximus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Ethiopian highland hare?
cards.explain: The Ethiopian highland hare is Lepus starcki.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Heck's macaque?
cards.explain: The Heck's macaque is Macaca hecki.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the European Polecat?
cards.explain: The European Polecat is Mustela putorius.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Eurasian Flying Squirrel?
cards.explain: The Eurasian Flying Squirrel is Pteromys volans.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Indian rhinoceros?
cards.explain: The Indian rhinoceros is Rhinoceros unicornis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Clymene dolphin?
cards.explain: The Clymene dolphin is Stenella clymene.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the wild boar?
cards.explain: The wild boar is Sus scrofa.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the honey possum?
cards.explain: The honey possum is Tarsipes rostratus.
